decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program directly extends the firm's psychiatric care expertise, enabling effective interpretation of feedback and improvement, so withdrawal is unlikely.
Carpentry is less central to the firm's care and therapy knowledge, but existing production know-how still allows learning, yielding a moderate drop risk.
Outpatient sociotherapy is closely related to existing mental health and social work, enabling the firm to assimilate results and refine the service with confidence.
Senior living counseling leverages established eldercare knowledge, allowing the firm to evaluate outcomes and adapt quickly, so withdrawal is unlikely.
Retail operations are less familiar than core care services, weakening absorptive capacity in this area, though sheltered workshop ties keep the drop probability moderate.
Meal delivery for seniors builds on the firm's established eldercare customer base, but the operational food service side is less familiar, giving a moderate-low drop risk.
